mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for two consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for two consecutive months above 5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns over the 60-day window are not statistically lower than during the prior 60-day window (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +0.5% in a month following a rate hike, it anticipates market anticipation of higher inflation, which drives a short-term negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly change > +0.5% and preceding FEDFUNDS > 5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS of at least 2% for three consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when labor momentum persists (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 grows at a quarterly rate above 4% in the quarter ending on the decision date, it reflects robust consumer demand, which is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the prior 20-day window (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 10% following a sharp drop in HOUST suggests supply-side stress, which predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when supply shock is detected.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3% for two consecutive months, it signals weaker labor market headwinds, which tends to support equity valuations and produce a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when unemployment is easing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime where FEDFUNDS remains below 4% for four consecutive months, the market anticipates lower policy tightening, which supports equity valuations and yields a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive during the low-rate period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous rise of RSAFS above 700 million and a decline in UNRATE below 4% in the same month suggests improved demand absorption and weaker labor constraints, which predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both indicators move in the predicted direction (t-test p > 0.05).
